Loop in `_parse_annotation` now only xrefs `nodes.Text` tokens.
- Verified: nitpicky autodoc build of `Literal[True]/[False]` overloads → 0 py:class warnings with fix; pristine checkout reproduces "py:class reference target not found: True/False". tests/test_domain_py.py: 42 passed, 3 pre-existing canonical failures (fail identically on pristine).
